title: Explore Atlanta Winemaking Experience
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
cancellation: All sales are final. No refund is available for cancellations.
blurb:
The Art of Winemaking Experience by Divine Libations offers more than just a tasting—it’s a hands-on journey where you create a wine that’s uniquely yours. Unlike traditional winery tours, we put you in control, guiding you through blending, bottling, and labeling your custom 375ml creation.

Elevate your wine with handcrafted simple syrups like Blueberry Peach or Habanero for a bold twist. Enjoy a complimentary glass of our premium wine, bring your own food (optional), and savor an unforgettable evening of creativity and connection.

This isn’t just winemaking—it’s a whole vibe.
